question.text: In a ferromagnetic material, below the curie temperature, a domain is defined as:

options.text: a macroscopic region with saturation magnetization.
a macroscopic region with consecutive magnetic dipoles oriented in opposite direction.
a macroscopic region with zero magnetization.
a macroscopic region with randomly oriented magnetic dipoles.

solution.text: In a ferromagnetic material, below the curie temperature, a domain is defined as a macroscopic region with saturation magnetization.
